summary_1line: Takshaka bribes sage Kasyapa to abandon curing King Parikshit, kills the king, and Janamejaya resolves to avenge him with a snake‑sacrifice.

image_candidates.scene_text: The serpent Takshaka bites a great banyan tree that instantly turns to ashes before the sage Kasyapa restores it to life.
Takshaka in disguise slips into the guarded palace and strikes King Parikshit with fiery venom.
King Janamejaya, weeping and squeezing his hands, swears before his ministers to destroy the entire race of snakes.
